verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a SaaS formation and compliance service, but the evidence shows no in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The Formation MCP server lets founders use their own external AI client rather than an assistant built into doola. Pulse's bookkeeping automation is an adjacent feature, not an AI assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
